caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which is a tall, ornate vase or urn. The vase is predominantly colored in shades of greenish-yellow with various highlights and shadows that give it a three-dimensional appearance. The top of the vase has a wide, scalloped rim with a flared and undulating edge. The body of the vase tapers down from the wide top and has vertically elongated, curved decorative elements. The neck of the vase connects to a faceted, multi-angled base, which is mounted on a gray, marble-textured rectangular plinth. The background is plain and a light beige color, with no additional objects or details present. In the lower right corner, there appears to be a small inscription or signature.
title: Vase
